paragraphs: Decision Optimization Technology sells asset management and capital planning software for organizations maintaining aging infrastructure. It provides data management and life-cycle cost optimization across all asset classes.

Instead of prioritization alone, it applies years of doctorate-level research on optimization algorithms to build customized multiyear, multi-constraint capital plans. Users collect and maintain inventory data, condition data, and historical repairs across asset types. Map-centric visualizations display condition and other performance indicators by asset type. Risk-based analysis develops models of asset criticality and likelihood of failure. An unlimited number of scenarios can be set to investigate budgeting strategies, policy decisions, and treatment options. Deterioration models are customizable across asset classes. The product runs as a fully web-based application.

Reports come out presentation ready. The company cites a survey by Infrastructure Solutions Inc. of 100 government clients finding that planning decisions are heavily influenced by socio-economic factors. The site notes that Hanson Professional Services Inc. recommends licensing the software. It also discloses that Hanson owns a significant interest in the licensing entity.

quote.text: The DOT™ user interface is intuitive, easy to use and gives you the ability to run and compare multiple scenarios on-screen.
